objects.description: One sitting of the council or one of its committees: what it is called, the day it is held, where, and which committee holds it. Agendas, minutes and resolutions hang off a meeting.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers. Set when the row is written.

fields.name: instance_id
fields.description: The agency the meeting belongs to. Every read is narrowed to one of these, so one agency never reads another's meetings.

fields.name: name
fields.description: What the meeting is called, such as "Budget session".

fields.name: date
fields.description: The day it is held, as YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: place
fields.description: Where it is held, in plain words. Empty when not yet fixed.

fields.name: committee
fields.description: The committee that holds it, as the committee group's name or id. Empty for a sitting of the whole council.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the meeting was put on record, as an RFC 3339 instant in UTC.

indexes.name: instance_date
indexes.description: Listing one agency's meetings by day.
